title: A no-charge line shows in the export as a $0.00 row with its category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billable, whose line 2 was No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open Export Reports.
  2. Pick Customer Invoice.
  3. Export today's file with the option unticked.
  4. Open the file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens.

Step 2:

  • The option shows unticked.

Step 3:

  • A file is exported.

Step 4:

  • Line 2's row reads 0.00 with "Goodwill" in its description.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R13: “The Customer Invoice export (S9-R6) shows a no-charge line of a billable invoice as a $0.00 row with the category in the description, without the option of S9-R6, since the invoice is a billable invoice.”
  • S9-R11: “With Show all on Technician Efficiency, internal and no-charge work orders count as work orders with their hours and no sales. In the export, internal and no-charge rows carry 0.00 on every line, their Classification and their Category (S9-R6); a no-charge line of a billable work order carries 0.00 on its own row with its Category. Every report, the export and the asset Invoices tab date a closed record by its posting date and a no-charge line by its invoice date.”
